stories: A lawyer who was passionate about soccer wanted to write about his childhood friendships formed playing the sport, the lasting nature of those friendships into adulthood, and how soccer had changed due to social transformation. The author warned him the project would be difficult, but the lawyer persevered for three years to complete the manuscript 'The Autumn of Our Lives.' When asked if it was publishable, the author said it needed one more rewrite. The lawyer agreed to revise it again, and the author believes the book may eventually be published.
